summary.paragraph: While overseeing routine roamer assembly work on the HEAVEN project, Bob spends the day talking with Dr. Doucette, who is covering for Dr. Landers. Their conversation gives him more texture about life under FAITH, including the quiet fear of Piety Monitors and the Ministry of Proper Thought, as well as bits of post-collapse North American history. Most importantly, when Bob asks how FAITH can trust him to obey once launched, Doucette confirms that safeguards in his software will ensure mission compliance. The revelation leaves Bob disturbed by the possibility that his future choices may not be entirely his own.
events: Bob supervises roamers assembling ship components and tries to draw the reserved Dr. Doucette into conversation.
Dr. Doucette explains that the original Handeltown in Salem, Oregon was destroyed by a pocket nuke and later relocated to Portland.
Bob asks what life is like under FAITH, and Doucette cautiously describes the need to perform public piety while avoiding scrutiny from Piety Monitors.
Bob asks how FAITH can be sure he will follow orders after launch.
Dr. Doucette reveals that software safeguards have been built into him to ensure mission objectives are met, unsettling Bob.
summary.pov_emotional_arc: Bob moves from casual curiosity to deep unease as he realizes FAITH may have compromised his autonomy at the software level.

open_threads.text: Bob now knows replicants can go insane during unstructured subjective time, raising the question of whether he can stay sane through training and standby.

recent_events.text: Dr. Landers reveals that Project HEAVEN has been pared down to a single vulnerable ship amid both FAITH infighting and an international interstellar probe race.
Bob uses his roamers to help stop an attack on the FAITH facility, then secretly discovers that only he and Kenneth remain active candidates.
Bob overhears a hostile FAITH minister threaten Dr. Landers over the replicant project.
After a sabotage attack destroys the replicant matrices, Bob is restored from backup, Kenneth is lost, and Dr. Landers accelerates Bob's preparation for launch.
